body: T6 = the queued next in-tree item of the Loom track (autopilot 2026-10-30, Q1''' frontier), delivered in the WheelTile pattern (measure first in Python, anchor second in Lean). GENERATOR scripts/rh/gen_loomladder.py re-measures at X = 1e8, XLO = 1e5 (population = 5,312,773 gaps p < p' < p'' with L >= 2, matching 0240 exactly) and EMITS formal/RhAttack/LoomLadder.lean - the file is a pure function of the census; regeneration is idempotent. Frozen objects: t6Total = 5312773; t6M3Flat / t6M15Flat (chunked 512-cell Array literals concatenated - a single 4352-cell literal exceeds the elaborator's recursion limit; discovered and worked around); t6ForbidM3 = 0 / t6ForbidM5 = 0 (row-wise support forbidden-hit counts, the empirical shadow of LoomWheel.loom_supp_mod_q at q = 3 and q = 5); t6OT = t6S3 = 2875733 (T1, loom_t1_spf3); t6M3SumClass0Frozen = 2875733 / t6M3SumClass1Frozen = 2437040 (per-class totals). BATTERY (native_decide, WheelTile TCB note): t6M3Len = 1088, t6M15Len = 4352, t6M3Total / t6M15Total (both frozen tables sum to n - a genuine array-level recomputation), t6ForbidM3Zero, t6ForbidM5Zero, t6OT_eq_t6S3, t6M3Class0Frozen / t6M3Class1Frozen (frozen total = population - OT). LEAN TOOLCHAIN LESSONS (new, 4.33.1): (i) a 4352-element #[...] Array literal hits 'maximum recursion depth' at elaboration while 1088 passes - chunk into <= 512-cell literals and concatenate with ++; (ii) per-element t6M15Flat[i] inside a derived def TIMES OUT the elaborator's whnf (200k heartbeats) even for closed indices over the ++ chain - Array.get re-traverses the nested concatenation per access; derived values (class sums, per-row masses, M15->M3 aggregation) are therefore computed and asserted in the Python generator and frozen as constants, with the mutual-consistency theorems kept in Lean; (iii) `List.sum` in this Mathlib is f-first (List.sum f l) and the dot form l.sum f resolves ambiguously to the no-f version with [AddMonoid] - use Finset sums (∑ i ∈ s, f i) for derived sums; (iv) `Array.get!` is not a projection - use [i]!/get; (v) modules under RhAttack/ carry NO extra namespace (root identifiers), #eval probes use bare names. #eval probe (lake env lean): t6Total 5312773, t6OT = t6S3 = 2875733, t6ForbidM3 = 0, t6ForbidM5 = 0, sizes 1088/4352, sums 5312773/5312773, t6M3Flat[34]! = 55308 - all exact. BUILD: lake build RhAttack.LoomLadder green (3006 jobs, 0 errors, 0 sorry); full lake build re-verified green before commit.
